thread:
oliver: Heads-up — ACME (Dedicated) asked for tenant-scoped canaries. They want to run per-tenant traffic splits (e.g. 5% canary, 95% stable) and be able to pin fallbacks to their dedicated pool. Concern: isolation + quota checks. Any blockers?

maria: Sounds doable in principle. Main questions: where do we enforce "per-tenant" routing? runtime? routing-service? need to avoid cross-tenant KV cache bleed.

devon: From product side, they want a simple UX: dropdown tenant -> slider for split -> optional hard guard (max qps, max tokens). Also audit trail.

serena: Telemetry note: canaries must tag traces and metrics with tenant_id and canary_tag. We need separate evaluation buckets so they can compare quality. Also need to ensure canary traffic doesn't share warm caches with stable.

oliver: Proposed API sketch — basic shape below. Thoughts on validation/guards?

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "canary": {
    "percentage": 5,
    "start_time": "2024-06-30T18:00:00Z",
    "guards": {
      "qps_limit": 100,
      "max_tokens_per_minute": 20000,
      "isolation_level": "dedicated-pool"
    }
  },
  "fallback": {
    "on_error": "stable",
    "pin_pool": true
  }
}
```

maria: Validation rules I'd add: percentage in [0,100], qps_limit <= tenant_commitment, isolation_level must be one of ["shared","dedicated-pool","hard-isolate"], and require admin approval for >10% on Dedicated.

devon: UX question — should we surface a simulated traffic estimate (expected qps) and a cost delta before they confirm? ACME asked for cost visibility.

serena: Also add "telemetry_mode": "full|sampled" so customers can opt into full traces during canary. Prefer sampled by default to avoid massive ingest.

oliver: Implementation concerns: routing-service needs to accept per-tenant override rules and consult a per-tenant feature flag store. We should avoid a global rule scan on every request. Maybe a TTL-cached map keyed by tenant_id + model.

maria: Agreed. Runtime change: route lookup cache + separate KV cache namespaces per isolation_level. For "dedicated-pool" we already have allocation boundaries, but need fast path to pin requests.

serena: For metrics, we need automatic SLO comparisons between canary and stable buckets (latency, error rate, semantic regressions). Suggest hook into existing eval pipeline.

devon: Product asks for A/B experiment mode too: instead of canary percent, allow deterministic hashing: e.g., user_id % 100 < 5 for stable selection. Useful for reproducibility.

oliver: Good idea — add "selector": {"type": "random|hash", "hash_key": "user_id"}. Keep default random to match existing traffic distribution.

maria: Security check: any per-tenant config API must enforce RBAC and audit logs. Also rate-limit config changes (no 100 quick flips).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service v2 (#3456) -> staging @ 1717006000 :rocket:

oliver: Action items: (1) Maria: write runtime design doc with cache + isolation options. (2) Serena: define telemetry tagging + eval hooks. (3) Devon: mockup console flow (slider + advanced JSON). (4) I'll draft API contract and validation rules. Aim for a spike next week. :white_check_mark:
